title: Concept: Lockfile entry without a resolved version
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry that carries no version string, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a version the entry cannot be compared to an advisory range, so a vulnerable install is invisible to every version-based check.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Without a version the entry cannot be compared to an advisory range, so a vulnerable install is invisible to every version-based check.
